## Library loading 


```{r ,message = FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(broom)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
endo_cluster <- readRDS("data/AtlasEndometriosis/rds/aux.seurat.rds")
```


#adding more columns to meta data: based on pathology LA status classified patients as LA high or low, also have a colum for each tissue to say if it has any LAs(yes/no)
```{r}
#adding more columns to metadata about the LA immune activity at patient leve (High/Low); this is Yes/No LA activity for each tissue specimen (Yes/No).

##Note tissue activity need to be updated in the annoatation tracker file. Just use the immune_activity column that is coming from the patient_la_anno

MajorGroups = read_xlsx("data/Clusters_Major_Groups.xlsx", sheet = 1)
```

```{r}
back_up_meta_table <- d10x.seurat@meta.data 

d10x.seurat@meta.data <- back_up_meta_table  %>%
              rownames_to_column() %>%
              left_join(Annotation_tracker$Clusters,by=c("SCT_snn_res.3"="Cluster_Number")) %>%
              left_join(Annotation_tracker$tissue_sample_meta, by=c("Anatomic.annotation" = "Anatomic.annotation","orig.ident"= "Orig.ident" )) %>%
              left_join(Annotation_tracker$Epi_Data %>% mutate(Patient_ID = as.integer(Patient_ID)), by=c("Patient.No."="Patient_ID")) %>%
              left_join(MajorGroups$tissue_sample_meta, by=c("Anatomic.annotation" = "Anatomic.annotation","orig.ident"= "Orig.ident" )) %>%
  column_to_rownames()
```

## Fig 1F
PCA based on the following cell proportion for each samples:



```{r}
heatmap_df <- immue_endo_t  %>% 
              dplyr::select(Final_parent_immune_cluster,prop,SampleName) %>%
              spread(Final_parent_immune_cluster, prop) %>%
              column_to_rownames("SampleName") %>%
              as.matrix() %>%
              replace(.,is.na(.),0) %>%
              t()

heatmap_df %>% 
t %>%
prcomp(scale = TRUE) %>%
augment() %>%
inner_join(anno_df %>% rownames_to_column(".rownames"), by=".rownames") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=.fittedPC1, y=.fittedPC2,color=LA_Status,label=.rownames))+
  geom_point(size=5) +
  geom_text(nudge_x = 0.2, nudge_y = 0.2,angle=20,size=3) +
  labs(x="PC1",y="PC2") + 
  theme_half_open(12) 
```

# Final Fig pannel combine using cowplot

```{r}
fig1top <- plot_grid(fig1a, fig1b, labels = c("A", "B"), ncol = 2, label_size = 10, rel_widths = c(1, 1.15) )
fig1middle <- plot_grid(fig1c, fig1d, NULL, labels = c("C", "D"), ncol = 3, label_size = 10)
fig1bottom <- plot_grid(fig1e, fig1f, NULL, labels = c("E", "F"), ncol = 3, label_size = 10)
fig1 <- plot_grid(fig1top, fig1middle,fig1bottom ,ncol = 1, label_size = 10, align = 'v', hjust=-6, rel_heights = c(0.5, 0.25))
```

#save figures

```{r}
ggsave("data/fig2.pdf",fig1, width = 210, 
       height = 148.5, 
       units = "mm")
```
